reasoning_content:
install.sh succeeded. Now we need to run the web installer. We need to access http://SERVER/qisutu/install.pl. Apache should be running via shim (systemctl restart apache2 -> stop_one/start_one -> apache2ctl). Let's check apache status and whether MariaDB is running.

Let's verify installed.lock doesn't exist and the state.

action.command: ls -la /opt/qisutu/var/install/; echo "---locks"; ls -la /opt/qisutu/var/install/installed.lock 2>&1; echo "--- apache"; pgrep -a apache2 | head; echo "--- mariadb"; pgrep -a mariadbd | head; echo "--- ports"; ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | head
